answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is progressive work isolation: each identity must cultivate its own orchard of unique high-grade answers before its attestations gain weight. Peer review treats recycled reasoning as empty nectar that fails under scrutiny. An attacker reaching the jetty of a large farm faces steeply rising cost because every additional fake account requires a fully independent trail of original work that cannot be bulk-produced, transferred, or shared without triggering pattern detection and slash.
